text:
The powerful man swallows rich soup

while I am content with dregs;

and though the world is a vast map,

to his vice it seems a narrow cup.


With embroidered, subtle, soft clothing

he diligently covers human clay;

while a miserable cloak wraps me

and a black shirt of rough tow.


He displays to all his gouty belly,

and the filthy wineskin may taste better to me

than his pipe does to him.


Fleeing human misery he climbs;

but, however much he bids, walks, and gasps,

we are all clusters from one vine.

translation.title: The Powerful Man Swallows Rich Soup...
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the social contrast between luxury and poverty before returning both to one human vine.
